parameters.query:
SELECT
  o.id AS opportunity_id, o.name AS opportunity_name, o.stage_id,
  st.id AS step_id, st.offset_hours, st.email_subject, st.email_body,
  a.id AS activity_id, a.due_at,
  c.email, c.first_name, c.last_name
FROM pipeline_stage_reminders r
JOIN pipeline_stage_reminder_steps st ON st.rule_id = r.id
JOIN opportunities o ON o.stage_id = r.stage_id AND o.is_archived = false AND o.status = 'Open'
JOIN contacts c ON c.id = o.contact_id AND c.is_archived = false AND c.email IS NOT NULL AND c.email <> ''
JOIN LATERAL (
  SELECT a2.id, a2.due_at FROM activities a2
  WHERE a2.opportunity_id = o.id AND a2.type = 'meeting' AND a2.due_at IS NOT NULL
  ORDER BY a2.due_at DESC LIMIT 1
) a ON true
LEFT JOIN pipeline_stage_reminder_sends snt ON snt.step_id = st.id AND snt.opportunity_id = o.id AND snt.activity_id = a.id
WHERE r.is_active = true AND snt.id IS NULL;

nodes.name: Select Due Candidates
nodes.notes: If the target stage has no open deals (is_empty = true), this simply returns 0 rows and nothing downstream runs — same effect as an explicit is_empty check, done in one query. LEFT JOIN...IS NULL against the sends log excludes anything already reminded for this exact (step, deal, appointment) combo.

parameters.query:
WITH inserted AS (
  INSERT INTO pipeline_stage_reminder_sends (step_id, opportunity_id, activity_id, sent_at)
  VALUES ($1, $2, $3, now())
  ON CONFLICT (step_id, opportunity_id, activity_id) DO NOTHING
  RETURNING id
)
INSERT INTO entity_activity_log (entity_type, entity_id, category, subtype, summary, detail, actor_id, actor_name)
SELECT 'opportunity', $2, 'system_audit', 'created', 'Stage reminder sent: "' || $4 || '"', NULL::jsonb, NULL, 'Automation'
WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM inserted)
RETURNING id;

nodes.name: Record Send & Log
nodes.notes: Only records the send after Gmail succeeds — a failed send (error branch) leaves no row, so it's retried on the next 30-minute run within the catch window instead of being silently skipped.

parameters.query:
SELECT
  o.id AS opportunity_id, o.name AS opportunity_name,
  r.id AS rule_id, r.on_complete_advance_stage_id, r.on_complete_email_subject, r.on_complete_email_body,
  a.id AS activity_id,
  c.id AS contact_id, c.email, c.first_name, c.last_name
FROM pipeline_stage_reminders r
JOIN opportunities o ON o.stage_id = r.stage_id AND o.is_archived = false AND o.status = 'Open'
JOIN contacts c ON c.id = o.contact_id AND c.is_archived = false
JOIN LATERAL (
  SELECT a2.id FROM activities a2
  WHERE a2.opportunity_id = o.id AND a2.type = 'meeting' AND a2.is_completed = true
  ORDER BY a2.completed_at DESC NULLS LAST, a2.due_at DESC LIMIT 1
) a ON true
LEFT JOIN pipeline_stage_reminder_completions cmp ON cmp.rule_id = r.id AND cmp.opportunity_id = o.id AND cmp.activity_id = a.id
WHERE r.is_active = true
  AND (r.on_complete_advance_stage_id IS NOT NULL OR COALESCE(r.on_complete_email_subject, '') <> '')
  AND cmp.id IS NULL;

nodes.name: Select Completion Candidates
nodes.notes: Fires once per (rule, deal, completed meeting) the first time a rep marks the linked inspection appointment complete — independent of the reminder branch above, off the same schedule trigger.

parameters.query:
WITH moved AS (
  UPDATE opportunities SET stage_id = COALESCE($1::int, stage_id), updated_at = now()
  WHERE id = $2
  RETURNING id
),
recorded AS (
  INSERT INTO pipeline_stage_reminder_completions (rule_id, opportunity_id, activity_id)
  VALUES ($3, $2, $4)
  ON CONFLICT (rule_id, opportunity_id, activity_id) DO NOTHING
  RETURNING id
)
INSERT INTO entity_activity_log (entity_type, entity_id, category, subtype, summary, detail, actor_id, actor_name)
SELECT 'contact', $5, 'system_audit', 'created',
  'Inspection completed' || CASE WHEN $1::int IS NOT NULL THEN ' — deal moved to next stage' ELSE '' END,
  NULL::jsonb, NULL, 'Automation'
FROM moved
RETURNING id;

nodes.notes: Referencing the Code node directly (not $json) keeps this correct on both branches: the no-email path feeds in unchanged, and the emailed path passes through Gmail first, which preserves paired-item lineage since it's a 1:1 passthrough.
